tables.name: tenant
tables.note: Business isolation boundary. Status active/restricted/cancelled; current state is not historical booking policy.

tables.name: branch
tables.note: One default branch in V1; multiple in V2. Partial unique default and at-least-one default enforced in migrations/service.

tables.name: membership
tables.note: owner/frontdesk initially; local status check required on every protected request.

tables.name: branch_membership
tables.note: One default grant V1. V2 server validates branch-scoped capabilities; JSON codes are allowlisted.

tables.name: customer
tables.note: At least one usable verified contact according to channel policy; guest checkout requires email. Do not merge people on phone alone.

tables.name: product
tables.note: Style-level marketing entry, not stock quantity.

tables.name: product_variant
tables.note: Units cm/in, validated numeric measurement map. Pricing mode fixed_duration/daily; explicit nonnegative amounts and bounded minutes.

tables.name: physical_asset
tables.note: branch_id is administrative home/holding branch; actual custody can be customer/transit. Location optional until V2.

tables.name: file_object
tables.note: Accepted evidence has exact version/checksum/frozen timestamp. Upload expiry is not evidence retention. Delete all applicable versions.

tables.name: product_image
tables.note: Order zero is primary image; only public derivatives may be exposed.

tables.name: storefront
tables.note: One storefront per tenant initially, globally unique path slug. Branch selector added V2 without duplicating tenant identity.

tables.name: policy_snapshot
tables.note: Immutable policy version once referenced. Terms acceptance stored on reservation.

tables.name: payment_method
tables.note: Sensitive destination metadata; owner edits only. New version rather than changing already shown instructions; rail cash/manual_qr/manual_transfer.

tables.name: reservation
tables.note: Customer/contact may be absent for anonymous short hold; required before pending_confirmation. Snapshot fields validated by state. Canonical reservation states in model doc.

tables.name: reservation_line
tables.note: One serialized garment per line. One line in V1 UI. No quantity greater than one; allocation assigns the physical asset.

tables.name: maintenance_work_order
tables.note: cleaning/repair/manual_block; planned interval represented by asset_allocation. Actual readiness independently checked.

tables.name: asset_allocation
tables.note: Exactly one source FK. EXCLUDE gist tenant_id =, asset_id =, period && WHERE is_blocking. Nonempty bounded [) range. Holds/pending/confirmed/turnaround all block; deterministic transition contract.

tables.name: custody_event
tables.note: Immutable actual facts independent of planned exclusion. Exactly matching intent is duplicate-safe; real lateness never rejected due to future allocations.

tables.name: disruption
tables.note: Overdue/unready asset threatens upcoming booking; operator resolves substitute/new dates/refund with customer. Do not silently auto-cancel.

tables.name: payment
tables.note: Exactly one reservation/fitting. Pending intent may change through guards; verified amount/currency/reference immutable; corrections use reversals. Merchant reference uniqueness needs method/provider scope.

tables.name: payment_receipt
tables.note: Evidence does not imply receipt of funds. File must be finalized, private, same tenant.

tables.name: payment_verification
tables.note: Immutable review decisions; only one successful settlement per payment via locked conditional transition. Private notes not application logs.

tables.name: charge
tables.note: Immutable nonnegative charge or linked credit/reversal. Exactly one rental/fitting. Security deposit liability is not a revenue charge.

tables.name: payment_allocation
tables.note: Immutable apply/reverse toward charge; reversal bounded by original. Same booking and currency required beyond tenant FK.

tables.name: refund
tables.note: requested/processing/completed/failed/cancelled; reserve refundable balance for pending instructions. Manual completion verified; never reissue automatically on uncertain transfer.

tables.name: deposit_entry
tables.note: Immutable receive/release/apply/reversal. Exactly linked financial effect; apply pairs with charge payment allocation and release with refund. See balance formulas.

tables.name: guest_access_token
tables.note: High entropy bearer secret only returned once, hash stored; scopes allowlisted per state. Reference is not auth.

tables.name: idempotency_record
tables.note: Principal includes staff or anonymous checkout session namespace; terminal business keys outlive request cache.

tables.name: outbox_event
tables.note: pending/leased/succeeded/dead; at-least-once. Payload minimum IDs, no bearer secrets. Worker tenant scopes each domain operation.

tables.name: webhook_inbox
tables.note: Global pre-tenant inbox, separate restricted worker role; no raw token/PII payload. Verify signature before insert; provider data fetched/reconciled securely.

tables.name: notification_delivery
tables.note: Recipient resolved from authorized record at send time; queued vs provider accepted vs delivered/bounced distinguished.

tables.name: audit_event
tables.note: Append-only metadata. No full before/after sensitive payloads; actor can be staff/operator/system namespace.

tables.name: import_job
tables.note: Preview validates rows; commit all-or-nothing for V1 bounded imports. Larger batches explicit later, no silent partial success.

tables.name: export_job
tables.note: Durable queue record; permission rechecked at download. Generated CSV protects formula injection.

tables.name: plan
tables.note: Owner confirmed Starter30000 Professional49900 Business129900 PHP minor units/month. Immutable price versions.

tables.name: plan_entitlement
tables.note: Limits and release flags both required; null means nonnumeric capability, not implicitly unlimited.

tables.name: subscription
tables.note: Current subscription one/tenant. Versioned plan pointer; history captured in subscription_event. Restriction preserves existing rental settlement.

tables.name: subscription_event
tables.note: Immutable commercial transition history; no silent repricing existing period.

tables.name: subscription_payment
tables.note: Rentivo revenue collection only; never shares merchant rental payment balances.

tables.name: support_grant
tables.note: Time-bound tenant-scoped operator permission; private documents separate capability; no universal bypass role.

tables.name: fitting_appointment
tables.note: Appointment confirmed only after all required resources and promised garment blocks claim atomically.

tables.name: fitting_line
tables.note: Guaranteed garment requires asset plus asset_allocation; unassigned preference must not claim guarantee.

tables.name: fitting_resource
tables.note: Individual room/staff/capacity slot, capacity one per resource. Model N capacity as N identifiable slots.

tables.name: resource_allocation
tables.note: EXCLUDE same tenant/resource overlapping period WHERE is_blocking. Appointment or closure/break; explicit source check.

tables.name: fitting_hours
tables.note: Allow multiple windows per day; date exceptions become resource_allocation closures. Timezone from branch.

tables.name: location
tables.note: Physical room/rack/storage; transit tracked as custody state, not fake destination stock.

tables.name: transfer_order
tables.note: Distinct branches same tenant. requested/approved/in_transit/partially_received/completed/cancelled; each line independent arrival.

tables.name: transfer_line
tables.note: Physical unit one line. Pending transfer alone does not update custody or branch availability.

tables.name: transfer_event
tables.note: Immutable dispatch/receive/lost/cancel event. Winning state transition updates current asset location and custody atomically.
